ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*set.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*mshta.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*vbscript\\:createobject.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.run.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(window\\\.close\\).*"))
